shaders.name: UI/Particles/Premultiply Alpha
shaders.fragmentFormula: texture * Tint * vec4(Color.rgb * Color.a * UV1.x, Color.a * UV1.x * UV1.y)

shaders.name: UI/Particles/Additive
shaders.fragmentFormula: texture * (vertexColor * 2) * Tint; native SrcAlpha/One is folded into the zero-alpha browser contribution

evidence.limitation: No guessed/nativeInitial defaults. Native initial states, burst mesh streams and shader draw validation are required before presentation parity claims.
